en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a landscaped cemetery or park cemetery with monumental tombs and sculptures. In the foreground are stone grave monuments and a central fountain-like structure with a seated figure sculpture. In the background stands a large mausoleum-style building with columns and statues. Trees and paths surround the funerary monuments. German text is printed at the top of the card.
